recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision changes the broader policy for non-standard resource representations.
issue_request: FHIR-5145 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Base Resource ballot item asking to delete wording that made validity ambiguous for resource representations other than XML or JSON, and to add a Formats note that other representations are allowed but not described by the specification.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git-svn revision 4577, now commit 7b95c3da0c57f5a0f27e6c9191b30dbf724f68a6. That commit removed the ambiguous Resource introduction wording and added the requested other-representations note to formats.html.
additional_context: Later commits for FHIR-18448 and FHIR-21452 split serialization-format material from formats.html into resource-formats.html and moved the note there. Current source/fhir.ini keeps Resource active in resource-infrastructure, and source/hierarchy.xml lists resource-formats.html as the Resource Formats page. Community searches found no relevant FHIR-5145-specific Zulip or Confluence decision that changes the source-history conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/resource/resource-introduction.xml only says resources have multiple representations and links to source/resource-formats.html, while source/resource-formats.html says other representations are allowed but not described by this specification. The deleted XML/JSON validity wording is absent from current source.
